title: Coral and the Smile
author: M. M. Montrose
blurb: Beatrix Amberdale, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
